# appwrite_function_execution (Action)

Executes an Appwrite function. Running a function is a thing done at a point in time, not a thing that exists, so it is an action rather than a resource: nothing is recorded in state and nothing is destroyed later.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `function_id` (String) The ID of the function to execute.

### Optional

- `async` (Boolean) Queue the execution and return immediately, rather than waiting for it to finish. An asynchronous execution that fails will not fail the action, because nothing waits to see it.
- `body` (String) The request body passed to the function.
- `method` (String) The HTTP method passed to the function. Defaults to POST.
- `path` (String) The request path passed to the function. Defaults to /.
- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) How long to wait for a synchronous execution to finish, in seconds. Defaults to 300.
